correctness.rationale: The vertex projection onto the opposite affine facet is its centroid. Affine linearity then gives distance hλⱼ and sends λⱼ to zero while adding λⱼ/d to every other coordinate. All projected coordinates are nonnegative, so these distances and projections really are to bounded facets. With distinct coordinates the strict order rotates as stated, with no subsequent tie. A tied block persists until maximal: each unique maximum above it moves below it, and cannot overtake the block while the latter remains unselected. Thus every weak order reaches the tied fixed set (or starts there). The arithmetic coordinate progression sums to one and rotates exactly, giving d! disjoint cycles with all phases distinct. Every complete strict-order itinerary uses each facet, and the product of their linear orthogonal projections is strictly contractive: equality would force a nonzero vector simultaneously tangent to all facets. There can be no other strict-order periodic orbit, and convergence is exponential phase by phase. Poincaré recurrence for the Borel map excludes all other points from an invariant probability, and invariance makes cycle weights uniform within each cycle. Ties have zero facet-area measure and label symmetry gives basin weights 1/d!. Independently propagating the two tetrahedral tangent vectors through j=3,2,1,0, scaling by 3 at each step, gives (0,−7,8,−1) and (0,−4,−7,11); the restricted matrix is therefore the stated matrix divided by 81, with determinant 1/81 and the claimed multipliers.
residual_risks: The exact finite checks described for d=3–6 do not prove the all-dimensional theorem and are not independently attested. The geometry and tie argument are specific to regular simplices and the stated stationary convention.

value.rationale: This resolves a natural, dimension-uniform regular-polytope case of Everett's higher-dimensional question, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The rank rule gives a complete division between exponential attraction and finite stopping, with an exact cycle census and a description of all stationary probabilities, including those invisible to uniform surface-area initialization. It does not claim a general result for irregular polytopes.
residual_risks: The exponential rate in general dimensions is not optimized; the invariant distributions on the fixed set need not describe a typical initialization.
